Rule: >= 8,000 and < 12,500 units -> Low-sales review queue activation level
Rule: < 2,000 units from a decision threshold -> Manual sales verification variance band
Rule: >= 25,000 and < 40,000 units -> Expanded replenishment planning level
Rule: >= 40,000 units -> Growth allocation review level
